summary: The remaining L1 plan extends the accepted ℤ_p determinant norm and actual cyclotomic interpolation to finite unramified coefficients. It separates coefficient-fixed substitution from arithmetic coefficient Frobenius, constructs the corrected norm projector, and proves twisted interpolation into the actual norm-compatible unit tower. It imports local arithmetic and measure theory from their existing owners.
conventions: p is a prime. E/ℚ_p is finite unramified; O is its native integer ring, a compact complete DVR finite free over ℤ_p with maximal ideal pO. The topology on B=O[[T]] is coefficientwise p-adic. Y=1+T and Φ(f)=f(Y^p−1) fixes coefficients. The scalar algebra on the second B has structural map Φ, not the ordinary self-algebra. All norms and traces are base-valued.

σ:O≃ₐ[ℤ_p]O is the canonical arithmetic p-Frobenius: its residue action is x↦x^p. Σ applies σ coefficientwise. σ is continuous, preserves p-power ideals, and fixes ℤ_p. It is not the q-power residue Frobenius when [E:ℚ_p]>1.

Choose ζ_n of exact order p^(n+1) in an algebraic closure of E, with ζ_(n+1)^p=ζ_n. E_n=E(ζ_n), O_n=integralClosure O E_n, π_n=ζ_n−1. Use the L0 native integral closure, inherited valuation topology, and inclusion-induced algebras. d_n=[E_n:E]=p^n(p−1). ε_n is native convergent series evaluation O[[T]]→O_n at π_n. σ_n extends σ and fixes ζ_n. ν_n is the native unit norm O_(n+1)ˣ→O_nˣ. U∞ is the subgroup of the product of these actual unit groups cut out by ν_n(u_(n+1))=u_n, with product/subtype topology.

The x_i are distinct: distinct powers of the primitive root give distinct nonzero constant-series differences, and multiplication by the unit Y preserves this. In the domain S[[T]], Matrix.det_vandermonde_ne_zero_iff gives det(V)≠0.

Take determinants in the matrix identity and cancel the nonzero det(V) in S[[T]]. RingHom.map_det identifies det(A_f) with map(ρ)(Φ(Nf)).
